runs.text: Which of these methods have been used by researchers to make thin glass fibers?

Sir Charles Vernon Boys used a crossbow to launch a partially melted glass rod to pull very fine glass fibers. This inspired Scientific American to publish a do-it-yourself recipe for readers with a miniature catapult design. Decades later, the British Post Office wanted to test out some fiber compositions without investing in massive equipment. One of their employees would run down the hall holding a pair of tongs, pulling a thin, molten fiber behind them.
